newsitem.title: USA: Optek gets automotive sensor contract.
newsitem.headline: Optek gets automotive sensor contract.

text.p: Optek Technology Inc said on Monday that the company has been selected as the supplier for ignition timing sensors on two separate engines for one of the major U.S. automobile manufacturers.
The name of the auto maker was not immediately available.

The company said it estimates that its revenue from these magnetoresistive sensors will total approximately $27.8 million over the first four years of production. Delivery is scheduled to begin in the second half of 1999, the company said.
